'''2007 Worlds Day 1 Brady Moore DS Carbon Chamber Testing''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Brady Moore]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Brady Moore]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Carbon Chamber Testing / My Favorite Decoration|Carbon Chamber Testing]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
